claim: AWS Backup Audit Manager has two types of reports, and you choose the type when you create a report: a jobs report, and a compliance report, which can monitor resource levels or the different controls that are in effect.

evidence.quote: There are two types of reports. When you create a report, you choose which type is created.

One type is a **jobs report**, which shows jobs finished in the last 24 hours and all active jobs with comprehensive context about vault properties, backup plan configurations, and lifecycle settings.
The second type of report is a compliance report. Compliance reports can monitor resource levels or the different controls that are in effect.
